```json
 "rationale": "StrongARM uses no static current, so energy is only switched charge. The output load costs about 10fF*1.8^2 = 32 fJ per comparison. That leaves about 60 fJ for internal nodes, so all devices are minimum-L and small (internal caps of a few fF). Latch time constant is about 15 ps. With ln(1.8/(Av*1mV)) of about 6, regeneration takes roughly 90 ps. Adding about 25 ps of integration and about 30 ps for the inverters gives an estimated 145 ps or less, just inside 150 ps."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "W_in":   (2.0, 0.84, 6.0),   # input pair width [um]
    "W_tail": (2.0, 0.84, 6.0),   # clocked tail switch [um]
    "W_ln":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),   # latch NMOS
    "W_lp":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),   # latch PMOS
    "W_rst":  (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),   # reset PMOS switches
    "W_on":   (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),   # output inverter NMOS
    "W_op":   (1.6, 0.6, 4.0),    # output inverter PMOS (drives CL rising edge)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    dv = spec.get("dv", 1e-3)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail + input pair
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_tail"], L)
    n.M("M1", "di1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    n.M("M2", "di2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch
    n.M("M3", "xo1", "xo2", "di1", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "xo2", "xo1", "di2", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "xo1", "xo2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "xo2", "xo1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge all internal nodes to VDD)
    n.M("R1", "xo1", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("R2", "xo2", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("R3", "di1", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("R4", "di2", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    # output inverters: vinp>vinn -> xo1 falls -> outp high
    n.M("I1n", "outp", "xo1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_on"], L)
    n.M("I1p", "outp", "xo1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_op"], L)
    n.M("I2n", "outn", "xo2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_on"], L)
    n.M("I2p", "outn", "xo2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_op"], L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cgate = 1.8e-15   # F/um (gate + overlap, L=0.15)
    cjd = 1.0e-15     # F/um drain junction
    c_xo = (p["W_on"] + p["W_op"] + p["W_ln"] + p["W_lp"]) * cgate \
           + (p["W_ln"] + p["W_lp"] + p["W_rst"]) * cjd
    c_di = (p["W_in"] + p["W_ln"] + p["W_rst"]) * cjd
    c_tail = (2 * p["W_in"] + p["W_tail"]) * cjd * 0.5

    # input pair at start of evaluation: Vgs ~ vcm (tail ~0)
    vds_in = 0.6
    opin = lut.op("n", p["W_in"], L, vcm - 0.05, vds_in)
    gm_in = max(opin["gm"], 1e-6)
    i_in = max(opin["Id"], 1e-6)
    # integration phase: discharge di (to VDD - Vthn) then xo by ~Vthn
    t_int = (c_di * 1.0 + c_xo * 0.6) / i_in
    av = gm_in * t_int / max(c_xo, 1e-16)
    av = min(max(av, 2.0), 30.0)
    # regeneration: n+p latch gm at mid-rail
    gn = lut.op("n", p["W_ln"], L, 0.9, 0.6)["gm"]
    gp = lut.op("p", p["W_lp"], L, 0.9, 0.6)["gm"]
    gm_l = max(gn + gp, 1e-6)
    tau = c_xo / gm_l
    t_regen = tau * math.log(vdd / (av * dv))
    # output inverter rising edge into CL
    ip_on = lut.op("p", p["W_op"], L, 1.5, 0.9)["Id"]
    t_inv = (cl + 2e-15) * (vdd / 2) / max(ip_on, 1e-6)
    delay = t_int + t_regen + t_inv

    # energy per comparison: one output charged + internal nodes recharged
    e_out = cl * vdd**2
    e_int = (1.3 * c_xo + 2 * c_di + c_tail) * vdd**2
    e_sc = 0.15 * e_out
    energy = e_out + e_int + e_sc

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
